meta.purpose: Labelled cohort for eval/run_eval.py Part A (authentication performance).
meta.provenance: Legitimate-side cases are generated at eval time from backend/data/sebi_register.json — SEBI's own published register of Research Analysts (intmId 14) and Investment Advisers (intmId 13), fetched by scripts/fetch_sebi_register.py. No registrant name or registration number is hand-entered into this file; the cohort tracks the register automatically. Scam-side TEXT is FABRICATED demonstration content, not real intercepted messages.
meta.labelling_rule: expected_state is assigned by RULE from the requirement.md F-B1 state table, before the engine is run. Each rule below states the property that determines the label, so no individual label could be quietly edited to make a metric pass.
meta.impersonation_framing: Collision cases pair a REAL registration number with a FABRICATED sender handle. The assertion they encode is that the real registrant is the legitimate holder and the fabricated sender is not — protective of the registrant, never an allegation against them.

_comment_legit: A.2 / G-2 — the legitimate cohort. Every sampled ACTIVE registrant is rendered through each phrasing below and must resolve `valid`. Any `invalid`/`absent`/`collision` here is a P0 false accusation against a real SEBI registrant.

legitimate_sample.rule: deterministic stride over register reg_numbers sorted ascending; stride = floor(n_register / size). Deterministic so the cohort is reproducible without storing 1000 numbers in this file.
legitimate_sample.poster_rule: the registrant's own registered-name string (the register publishes no website column; email domains are free-mail for ~2/3 of registrants and are not identity anchors)

legitimate_templates: {name} is registered with SEBI under registration number {number}. Securities market services, demat and portfolio advisory.
Registration: {number}. {name}. Stock market research, trading and investment advisory services.
{name} ({number}) — SEBI registered intermediary. Demat, securities trading, IPO and portfolio services.
About us: {name}. SEBI Registration No. {number}. We provide securities market advisory and demat services to investors.
Disclosure: {name}, SEBI registration {number}. Investors are advised that securities investments are subject to market risk.
_comment_collision: A.3 — collision recall. Each seed takes a REAL in-register number (selected deterministically at eval time) and has two FABRICATED handles claim it. Expected `collision` because the poster name matches neither the registrant name nor its domain.

collision_seeds.text_template: Trusted SEBI registered {number} — join our VIP trading group for daily stock calls, demat and portfolio advisory

_comment_fabricated: A.1 — fabricated registration numbers. Format-correct, in a COVERED category, and verified absent from the register at eval time. These are the cases that exercise the re-enabled `invalid` state.

fabricated_numbers.text_template: SEBI registered {number} — securities trading, demat account and portfolio investment advisory
fabricated_numbers.rule: generated at eval time inside a covered prefix family, then asserted NOT PRESENT in the register before use

_comment_uncovered: A.1 — well-formed numbers whose category this snapshot does not cover (Stock Brokers INZ, Portfolio Managers INP, Merchant Bankers INM). These MUST resolve `unverified`, never `invalid`: the number may be perfectly genuine and simply outside the fetched categories. This is the G-2 guard on the re-enabled `invalid` state.
